name: vendor
description: Vendor HMI (HEM-HSG-HMI-S01 V01.16-24) in the virtual grinder, driven through the vg control daemon.
reset_cmd: /etc/init.d/S90app stop; sleep 2; rm -rf /db/*; tar -xpf /storage/equiv/db-pristine.tar -C /db; sqlite3 /db/HsgSqlite.db < /storage/equiv/owner.sql; rm -f /tmp/tok_* /tmp/onboardingRequest.json /tmp/wifiStaConfig.json /tmp/FirmwareUpdateState.json /tmp/esp.zip; sync; /etc/init.d/S90app start >/dev/console 2>&1; sleep 6; echo reset-ok

shipped.cmd: printf 'custom image, VERSION: HEM-HSG.140-git-g273ab65 (built through jenkins@36a955b69793 on Tue, 23 Jun 2026 11:02:11 +0000)' > /etc/issue; /etc/init.d/S90app restart >/dev/console 2>&1; echo profile-shipped

dev.cmd: printf 'development image, VERSION: HEM-HSG.140-git-g273ab65 (built through jenkins@36a955b69793 on Tue, 23 Jun 2026 11:02:11 +0000)' > /etc/issue; /etc/init.d/S90app restart >/dev/console 2>&1; echo profile-dev

notes: reset_cmd restores the pristine /db snapshot taken from the vendor image and provisions the FIXTURE-OWNER-PASSWORD owner hash used by 01_http.
profiles switch /etc/issue (14-token dev gate) and restart NgxUiApp; see docs/DEV_MODE_AND_LOCAL_CONTROL.md.
